Color, location and size upgrades are available upon request and should be discussed with your tattoo artist.​Digital preview is for reference only, please see the hardcopy flash books in person for exact size/details. ​​DESIGNS AND PRICES ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE What is the Deal With Friday 13th? Friday the 13th discounts are a tradition in the tattoo community offering a chance to get tattoos honoring the occasion. With the number 13 often symbolizing bad luck, it's considered good luck to get a tattoo including the number, and Friday the 13th is the perfect time to do so. The legend goes that sailors would often get the number 13 tattooed so that bad luck would see the mark and pass them by. Since the holiday began in the 1990's it has grown to include many more tattoo designs and options than a simple number 13. One thing hasn't changed however, and that is Friday 13th is a great day to get killer deals on ink if you're willing to join the crowds. The Friday 13th tattoo tradition traces back to Oliver Peck, the co-owner of Elm Street Tattoo in Dallas, TX and a judge on the reality TV show “Ink Master.” Mr. Peck was included in the Guinness Book of World Records for drawing the most tattoos in a 24-hour period, after he tattooed the number “13” on 415 people on a Friday the 13th in June 2008.
